root_cause.text: The BPF subsystem failed to ensure that an `freplace` (extension) program and its target program have matching `kprobe_write_ctx` flags during attachment, allowing an extension program with register-writing privileges to modify `struct pt_regs` of a standard kprobe program.
root_cause.evidence: The patch in `kernel/bpf/syscall.c` adds a check in `bpf_tracing_prog_attach()` to reject the attachment of an extension program (`BPF_PROG_TYPE_EXT`) if its `kprobe_write_ctx` value differs from that of the target program (`tgt_prog`):

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a validation check to ensure freplace programs and their target programs have matching kprobe_write_ctx flags to prevent unauthorized register modification.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check in bpf_tracing_prog_attach to verify that BPF_PROG_TYPE_EXT programs have the same kprobe_write_ctx value as their target program, returning -EINVAL on mismatch.
intent_record.how: Prevents extension (freplace) programs from bypassing write restrictions on struct pt_regs by ensuring they cannot attach to target programs with differing kprobe_write_ctx permissions.

bic_trace_step.code_snippet:
commit 4a1e7c0c63e02daad751842b7880f9bbcdfb6e89
Author: Toke Høiland-Jørgensen <toke@redhat.com>
Date:   Tue Sep 29 14:45:51 2020 +0200

    bpf: Support attaching freplace programs to multiple attach points
    
    This enables support for attaching freplace programs to multiple attach
    points. It does this by amending the UAPI for bpf_link_Create with a target
    btf ID that can be used to supply the new attachment point along with the
    target program fd. The target must be compatible

    bpf: Add support for BPF_OBJ_GET_INFO_BY_FD for bpf_link
    
    Add ability to fetch bpf_link details through BPF_OBJ_GET_INFO_BY_FD command.
    Also enhance show_fdinfo to potentially include bpf_link type-specific
    information (similarly to obj_info).
    
    Also introduce enum bpf_link_type stored in bpf_link itself and expose it in
